blocks.content: Quiz: What is the minimum requirement for a function to be a valid custom hook?
Tap an option below to answer:
It must be defined in a separate file in a hooks/ folder
File location does not matter. The naming convention and internal hook call are what define a custom hook.
File location does not matter. The naming convention and internal hook call are what define a custom hook.
It must accept props as its first argument
Custom hooks can take any parameters you choose — not necessarily props.
Custom hooks can take any parameters you choose — not necessarily props.
Its name must start with use and it must call at least one hook inside it
The use prefix is required for React to apply hook rules, and calling a hook is what makes it a hook.
The use prefix is required for React to apply hook rules, and calling a hook is what makes it a hook.
It must return an object with at least one property
A custom hook can return any value — a primitive, array, object, function, or nothing at all.
A custom hook can return any value — a primitive, array, object, function, or nothing at all.
